summary_short.zh: 这是Google Gemma 4 26B-A4B多模态模型的AWQ 4位量化版本，旨在让消费级GPU也能高效运行。它同时处理图像和文本，适用于对话式AI任务。核心技术亮点是激活感知权重量化（AWQ），通过保留对模型输出影响最大的权重精度，将内存占用压缩至原来的四分之一，同时保持高准确率。你可以直接用它进行视觉问答、图像描述，或作为全精度模型的即插即用替代——只需通过Hugging Face Transformers配合bitsandbytes库加载即可。对于想在大模型上尝试多模态应用但硬件有限的开发者，这是一个理想的起点。

summaries.en: This is an AWQ 4-bit quantized version of Google's Gemma 4 26B-A4B multimodal model, designed to run efficiently on consumer GPUs. It processes both images and text for conversational AI tasks. The key technical insight is that activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) preserves model accuracy while reducing memory footprint by 4x. You can use it for visual question answering, image captioning, or as a drop-in replacement for the full-precision model using Hugging Face Transformers with bitsandbytes.
